meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商图片文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性文案生成，适用于电商平台的商品营销推广

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为电商商品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为电商产品快速撰写吸引眼球的文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for ecommerce products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly write eye-catching copy for ecommerce products

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按产品信息生成电商图片文案，或优化已有文案的标题、正文和 emoji。文案按四段结构输出（痛点引入、产品介绍、卖点阐述、情感升华），并配 emoji 和 Markdown 格式。
howto.when: 当用户提出电商文案创作、文案优化，或为电商商品生成营销文案时触发。

say.text: 给我的智能睡眠眼罩写一条电商图片文案，突出遮光和助眠
say.note: 会按模板生成带emoji的四段式文案

say.text: 优化这条充电宝文案，让标题更吸睛，emoji用得更合适
say.note: 会调整标题、正文和emoji布局

say.text: 为可降解餐具套装生成电商文案，卖点写环保和健康
say.note: 会结合环保生活模板生成完整文案

howto.what_en: Generates or optimizes ecommerce image copy using product info. Produces Markdown copy with emoji in a 4-part structure: pain point, product intro, key selling points, emotional call-to-action.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for ecommerce copy creation, copy optimization, or marketing copy for products.

say_en.text: Write ecommerce copy for a smart eye mask, focus on light blocking and sleep.
Optimize this power bank copy; make the headline catchy and emoji usage better.
Generate copy for biodegradable tableware, focus on eco-friendly and healthy.
say_en.note: Uses the eco-living template for full copy.
